description: This Java source file defines the HiveMqtt3ClientActor class, which manages MQTT 3.1.1 client connections within an Akka actor system. It provides factory methods for creating Props, handles connection and disconnection, and starts publisher and consumer actors for MQTT messaging.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing MQTT 3.1.1 client connection lifecycle, subscriptions, and message publishing for MQTT communication.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory methods to create Props for actor instantiation with various parameters.

methods.name: createSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Creates a subscription handler specific to MQTT 3, managing incoming subscriptions and messages.

methods.name: sendConn
methods.description: Initiates connection to the MQTT broker with specified clean session settings.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Starts an actor responsible for publishing MQTT messages.

methods.name: startConsumerActor
methods.description: Starts an actor responsible for consuming MQTT messages from subscriptions.
